d: Mokama ke vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi kal hone ja rahi hai, jise lekar unke paitrik ganv ladma men taiyariyan joron par hain. do dinon tak ladma men huee bhari barish ke bad ab sabhi vyavasthaen durust kar li gaee hain aur aaj vidhayak anant sinh svayan ekshan mod men najar aae. unhonne apne khas mehmanon ke svagat aur thaharne ke intjamon ka khud jayja liya.
